description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Settlement Orders No. 256 (Matale) Final Orders for Digampathaha, Dambulla D/S Division, Matale District in Block Survey Village Plan No. 529 (Central)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land settlement orders under the Land Settlement Ordinance, specifically addressing the final settlement of numerous land lots in the Matale District. It contains detailed schedules listing land numbers, extents, and the parties on whom the lands are settled (including both The State and named individuals), which falls squarely under land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters as defined for Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
